limitations: Fixed Week 5 weights; no refitting or automatic promotion.
EMH is a sportsbook benchmark, not an invented additive variable.
Fresh order-book midpoints are probability inputs, not executed prices. Returns use saved sportsbook odds hypothetically, with holds preserved.
Time-aligned controls use historical price-series samples, not historical executable bid/ask or verified trade freshness.
Quote timestamps differ: improvement cannot automatically be attributed to the Polymarket platform.
Integer spreads and missing/stale/ambiguous contracts are excluded; original football picks are never replaced.
